item.title: [Lanka Talks] TBWA\Sri Lanka Named No. 1 at 2026 Dragons
item.description:
TBWA\Sri Lanka has been named the No. 1 Industry Leader at the 2026 Dragons of Sri Lanka, securing seven awards across four campaigns — one Gold, two Silver, two Bronze and two Black Dragons.
